title: Great for the price
text: Great for the price. 4 out of 5 because the glass cups it comes with hold only 3 oz (to the top) and are impractical. The steeper itself is great quality and you can easily get around 2 full mugs worth of tea. The steeper is super fine and does not leave loose tea residue in the pitcher. Would recommend but invest in other glasses.
